speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: The six pairs are still on the bench. Wednesday has come and gone. You are not walking to the Rother end. You are not walking to the lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They were mine to walk. I wrote sheep for kid. That was the bargain you set me, and I took it.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: And now you have a back, and the man still has the wrong wool in our name. I'll carry them. I'll say at his door that the writing was yours. I will not make your speech, and I will not wait until you are proud enough to limp it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: How would you have me mend it, then, if I cannot be the legs?

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: If you want it carried, say carried. If you want it admired, fetch another man.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Carried. Thank you. Say it was my hand. Bring kid back if he will change them, and the sheep if he will not.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Six pairs. I'll be back before dark, or I won't, and either way you are not to meet me on the stair to supervise a bundle.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I won't. The stair and I have no appointment.
